params.agreement_rule: a cross-model part pair agrees when the overlap of their top-k series is larger than two random k-subsets give (exact hypergeometric p, BH at q=0.05 within the concept); beyond_stratum records whether the overlap also beats redraws with the same per-stratum composition. rho over all series is reported as broad co-variation only: on the 4-model run rho 0.804 came with zero top-k overlap
params.residualization_basis: tier_* and real-derived generator_* dummies only; archetype_* and synthetic generators are structural recipes, so residualizing on them removes the structure being measured
